messages.content: Calculate the volume of the sphere with radius 3 units.

function.name: calculate_park_area
function.description: Calculate the total area of a park based on the radius of its circular part. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

radius.description: The radius of the circular part of the park. This is a float type value.

shape.description: The shape of the park. Default is 'circle'.

message.content:
Sure! The volume \(V\) of a sphere with radius \(r\) is given by

\[
V=\frac{4}{3}\pi r^{3}.
\]

For a radius of \(3\) units:

\[
V=\frac{4}{3}\pi(3)^3=\frac{4}{3}\pi(27)=36\pi \approx 113.10\text{ cubic units}.
\]
message.reasoning: The user asks: "Calculate the volume of the sphere with radius 3 units." They want the volume of a sphere. The tool calculate_park_area calculates area of a park based on radius of its circular part. That is not relevant. There's no tool for volume. So we should respond that we cannot compute volume because the tool only calculates area. We can provide formula manually: V = (4/3)πr^3. For r=3, V = (4/3)*π*27 = 36π ≈ 113.097. But we can't use the tool. So we can do it ourselves. The user didn't specify units. We can give answer in cubic units. So we can respond with calculation.
